scope: Fixed-point theorems for correspondences, as a base for existence of equilibrium in heterogeneous-agent models: Brouwer and Schauder carried from Stokey, Lucas and Prescott Chapter 17; Kakutani's theorem for nonempty compact convex sets in any real normed space with a closed graph (Kakutani 1941, Bohnenblust-Karlin 1950, Glicksberg 1952) by approximate continuous selections and Schauder; closed graph into a compact set implies upper hemicontinuity.
source: Kakutani (1941); Bohnenblust and Karlin (1950); Glicksberg (1952); Cellina (1969); Aliprantis and Border, Infinite Dimensional Analysis (2006), Ch. 17; Stokey, Lucas and Prescott (1989), Theorems 17.3-17.4; Rogers (1980).
